saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 40s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 20s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin returns with water: +3 clean.
🚶 A woman, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose is back — found A person, maybe 20s.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with sun-creased eyes returns with water: +3 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin eats with A woman, maybe 40s — bowls side by side, talk low.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose and A person, maybe 60s are arguing about the watch rotation. Again. It's almost comforting.
A man, maybe 40s: "Walked past a good stand of a tall grass with a dense bottle-brush grain head. Worth remembering where."
★ IDENTIFIED: Kapok Seeds. Kapok. Giant tree, silky pods, dark seeds. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
A man, maybe 40s brought you a sample. The Journal grows.
Adrian and Barbara lingered over the fire together.
Adrian and Betty lingered over the fire together.
Omar and Barbara lingered over the fire together.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Kapok Seeds — named and noted.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Adrian sets their bowl down. “Nadia, your past story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Nadia. Everybody does.

Nadia is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not Denver — Toronto, Canada. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
My Gia reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A woman, maybe 40s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A man, maybe 40s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 60s watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s says. (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Elijah," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Elijah." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Elijah).
"Adrian," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Adrian." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Adrian).
"Omar," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Omar." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Omar).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 A woman, maybe 50s needs 3 Dandelions. "For tea. For morale. For reasons."
"You haven't earned that yet," Adrian says. (Trust too low.)

🌿 A woman, maybe 40s checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A woman, maybe 40s hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)

No walls. No warning but the noise.
